## Observation datasets

### fayalite\_bejina\_2021\_table1\_pvt\_elastic

- **Description:** All 60 fayalite observations in the publisher-provided Table 1 workbook, including stress-corrected pressure, temperature, unit-cell parameters, volume, and measured P- and S-wave velocities.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_lattice\_parameters\_wave\_velocities
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Béjina; Bystricky; Tercé; Whitaker; Chen
    - **Year:** 2021
    - **Source:** Eur. J. Mineral.
    - **Volume:** 33
    - **Locator:** 519-535
    - **DOI:** 10.5194/ejm-33-519-2021
- **Source location:** Table 1 and publisher XLSX
- **Associated EOS records:** fayalite\_b\_jina\_2021\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** All tabulated uncertainties are explicitly 1 sigma. PFa is the NaCl pressure corrected for the measured differential stress in both NaCl and fayalite. Wave velocities were not measured for diffraction pattern 156 and are left blank.
